title: Journey chapter baseline audit
method: Frozen actual8e runtime served on an owned ephemeral localhost port; isolated headless Chromium,2D only. Existing achievements pre-earned, actual ctx.awardXP captured. Existing accessibility findings are diagnostic, not candidate failures.

cases.label: idle-320
cases.text:
💧
Journey Mode
FOLLOW ONE DROPLET
▶ Play the droplet journey (J)

Journey inactive. Start Journey to follow one droplet.

Goal: ride one droplet from the ocean back to the ocean. You will start in the ocean, evaporate, drift into a cloud, fall as rain, then pick a path at the ground (river runoff, underground infiltration, or absorbed by a plant). Each path takes a different amount of time. Complete the loop to log a journey; 3 loops unlocks the Journey badge.

Become a water droplet and travel through the entire water cycle! Make choices at each stage and learn the science behind each transformation.
